import MilneLib.Affine.StableAffineSections
import MilneLib.Sheaf.ModuleSectionTransport

/-!
# Sections of an equivariant sheaf of modules

A linearization of a native sheaf of modules is specified by its semilinear
transport maps, with the unit and cocycle expressed using the pushforward
functors. On a stable open these maps give the same contravariant section
action as the structure sheaf.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe w u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry
open scoped AlgebraicGeometry

namespace MilneLib.StableGroupAction

variable {G : Type w} [Group G] {X : Scheme.{u}}
  (act : G →* Aut X) (F : X.Modules)

/-- A linearization of a sheaf of modules for a group action on its scheme.
The maps are the adjoint form of the usual pullback linearization; the
pushforward coherence maps keep the unit and cocycle native to `X.Modules`.
-/
structure ModuleLinearization where
  hom : ∀ g : G, F ⟶ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (act g).hom).obj F
  one : hom 1 ≫
      (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (act_one_hom act)).hom.app F =
    (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardId X).inv.app F
  mul : ∀ g t : G,
    hom (g * t) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardCongr (act_mul_hom act g t)).hom.app F =
      hom g ≫ (Scheme.Modules.pushforward (act g).hom).map (hom t) ≫
        (Scheme.Modules.pushforwardComp (act t).hom (act g).hom).hom.app F

namespace ModuleLinearization

variable {act F} (D : ModuleLinearization act F)

/-- A linearization transports sections of a stable open to themselves. -/
noncomputable def actApp {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsStableOpen act U) (g : G) :
    Γ(F, U) ⟶ Γ(F, U) :=
  (D.hom g).appLE U U (hU g).ge

/-- The transport at the identity fixes every section. -/
theorem actApp_one {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsStableOpen act U) :
    D.actApp hU 1 = 𝟙 Γ(F, U) := by
  unfold actApp
  rw [← Scheme.Modules.Hom.appLE_pushforwardCongr (act_one_hom act), D.one]
  exact Scheme.Modules.appLE_pushforwardId_inv F U

/-- The linearization cocycle gives contravariant composition on sections. -/
theorem actApp_mul {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsStableOpen act U) (g t : G) :
    D.actApp hU (g * t) = D.actApp hU g ≫ D.actApp hU t := by
  symm
  simp only [actApp]
  rw [Scheme.Modules.Hom.appLE_comp_appLE, ← D.mul g t,
    Scheme.Modules.Hom.appLE_pushforwardCongr]

/-- The sheaf section transport is semilinear for structure-sheaf transport. -/
theorem actApp_smul {U : X.Opens} (hU : IsStableOpen act U) (g : G)
    (r : Γ(X, U)) (s : Γ(F, U)) :
    D.actApp hU g (r • s) = StableGroupAction.actApp act hU g r • D.actApp hU g s :=
  Scheme.Modules.Hom.appLE_smul (D.hom g) (hU g).ge r s

/-- Restriction between stable opens commutes with linearized transport. -/
theorem actApp_map {U V : X.Opens} (hU : IsStableOpen act U)
    (hV : IsStableOpen act V) (hVU : V ≤ U) (g : G) :
    D.actApp hU g ≫ F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op =
      F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op ≫ D.actApp hV g := by
  rw [actApp, actApp, Scheme.Modules.Hom.appLE_map, Scheme.Modules.Hom.map_appLE]

/-- The equivariance identity iterates across two successive stable-open
restrictions, as required on triple overlaps. -/
@[reassoc]
theorem actApp_map_comp {U V W : X.Opens} (hU : IsStableOpen act U)
    (hV : IsStableOpen act V) (hW : IsStableOpen act W)
    (hVU : V ≤ U) (hWV : W ≤ V) (g : G) :
    D.actApp hU g ≫ F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op ≫
        F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op =
      F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op ≫
        F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hWV).op ≫ D.actApp hW g := by
  rw [← Category.assoc, D.actApp_map hU hV hVU g, Category.assoc,
    D.actApp_map hV hW hWV g]

/-- The left action on sections obtained by transport along inverse group
elements, matching `sectionsMulSemiringAction` on scalars. -/
@[reducible]
noncomputable def sectionsDistribMulAction {U : X.Opens}
    (hU : IsStableOpen act U) : DistribMulAction G Γ(F, U) where
  smul g s := D.actApp hU g⁻¹ s
  one_smul s := by
    change D.actApp hU 1⁻¹ s = s
    rw [inv_one, D.actApp_one]
    rfl
  mul_smul g t s := by
    change D.actApp hU (g * t)⁻¹ s = D.actApp hU g⁻¹ (D.actApp hU t⁻¹ s)
    rw [mul_inv_rev, D.actApp_mul]
    rfl
  smul_zero g := map_zero (D.actApp hU g⁻¹).hom
  smul_add g s t := map_add (D.actApp hU g⁻¹).hom s t

theorem sectionsDistribMulAction_smul_def {U : X.Opens}
    (hU : IsStableOpen act U) (g : G) (s : Γ(F, U)) :
    letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction hU
    g • s = D.actApp hU g⁻¹ s := rfl

/-- The induced action is semilinear over the existing action on section rings. -/
@[reducible]
noncomputable def sectionsSMulDistribClass {U : X.Opens}
    (hU : IsStableOpen act U) :
    letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act hU
    letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction hU
    SMulDistribClass G Γ(X, U) Γ(F, U) := by
  letI := sectionsMulSemiringAction act hU
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction hU
  exact ⟨fun g r s => D.actApp_smul hU g⁻¹ r s⟩

/-- Actual restriction of sheaf sections is equivariant on stable opens. -/
theorem sectionsRestriction_equivariant {U V : X.Opens}
    (hU : IsStableOpen act U) (hV : IsStableOpen act V) (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (g : G) (s : Γ(F, U)) :
    letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction hU
    letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction hV
    F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op (g • s) =
      g • F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op s := by
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction hU
  letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction hV
  exact ConcreteCategory.congr_hom (D.actApp_map hU hV hVU g⁻¹) s

variable (F)

/-- Sections on a smaller open are modules over the larger open's section
ring through the actual restriction of regular functions. -/
@[reducible]
noncomputable def sectionsRestrictionModule {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U) :
    Module Γ(X, U) Γ(F, V) :=
  Module.compHom Γ(F, V) (X.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom

/-- The actual restriction map on sheaf sections, linear over the section
ring of the larger open. -/
noncomputable def sectionsRestrictionLinearMap {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U) :
    letI := sectionsRestrictionModule F hVU
    Γ(F, U) →ₗ[Γ(X, U)] Γ(F, V) := by
  letI := sectionsRestrictionModule F hVU
  exact
    { toFun := F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op
      map_add' := map_add (F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op).hom
      map_smul' := fun r s => F.map_smul (homOfLE hVU) r s }

@[simp]
theorem sectionsRestrictionLinearMap_apply {U V : X.Opens} (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (s : Γ(F, U)) :
    letI := sectionsRestrictionModule F hVU
    sectionsRestrictionLinearMap F hVU s = F.presheaf.map (homOfLE hVU).op s := rfl

variable {F}

/-- The linear restriction map satisfies the equivariance required for
invariant-module descent on a stable affine overlap. -/
theorem sectionsRestrictionLinearMap_equivariant {U V : X.Opens}
    (hU : IsStableOpen act U) (hV : IsStableOpen act V) (hVU : V ≤ U)
    (g : G) (s : Γ(F, U)) :
    letI := sectionsRestrictionModule F hVU
    letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction hU
    letI := D.sectionsDistribMulAction hV
    sectionsRestrictionLinearMap F hVU (g • s) =
      g • sectionsRestrictionLinearMap F hVU s :=
  D.sectionsRestriction_equivariant hU hV hVU g s

end ModuleLinearization

end MilneLib.StableGroupAction
